description_en: You can call this API to query the authorization progress by using the unique ID (CheckProgressId) returned from the batch device authorization API
description_zh: 调用该接口根据批量授权设备接口返回的唯一ID（CheckProgressId）查询授权的进度
kebab_example: aliyun iot check-bind-license-device-progress --iot-instance-id iot-2ws0000 --license-code 720P --product-key uhf50000 --check-progress-id 230000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckBindLicenseDeviceProgress

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- For a new public instance or an Enterprise instance, the instance has an ID value, which must be provided. Otherwise, the API invocation will fail.
- For a legacy public instance, the instance does not have an ID value, so it is not required.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

- 对于旧版公共实例，实例无ID值，无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
